stories.title: Father who helped family escape burning Houston townhome dies from injuries
stories.summary: A father who suffered severe burns while helping his family escape a burning Heights townhome has died, according to the Buzbee Law Firm.

stories.title: Bastrop launches pilot program to help downtown businesses pay for live music
stories.summary: The city will cover 30% of eligible musician fees, reimbursing businesses up to $400 per performance, with a monthly cap of $1,200 per business.

stories.title: Family seeks answers after single mother of two struck and killed while walking puppy in NW Houston
stories.summary: Grecia Gonzalez was killed while walking her dog in northwest Houston. Her family is now calling for safety improvements as investigators seek answers.

stories.title: Inmate's escape attempt at Beaumont prison foiled by vigilant TDCJ staff
stories.summary: An inmate at the Larry Gist Unit attempted an escape early Friday but was swiftly recaptured by correctional officers, says the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

stories.title: Bad fuel complaints leave Southeast Texas families facing thousands in repairs
stories.summary: 3 Southeast Texas families say bad fuel caused more than $10,000 in repairs. They are waiting on insurance decisions to find out if they are covered.

stories.title: One person dead in 18-wheeler explosion at I-35 on San Antonio's northeast side, police say
stories.summary: The vehicle fire could be seen from traffic cameras at Toepperwein and I-35 on Friday morning.

stories.title: 'Mom, I smell fire!': Two brothers help save family of 8 from house fire days before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A 13-year-old's early wake-up call and his 9-year-old brother's warning about smoke helped their mother and five siblings escape a devastating west-side house fire.

stories.title: Holden the Hondo Owl does more than bring school spirit as the mascot. She also signs the national anthem.
stories.summary: Hondo High School is preparing to say goodbye to its Star Signers—a group of seniors, including the mascot, who have signed the national anthem at games for years.

stories.title: 'Play hard, live responsibly': SAPD warns San Antonio gamers not to try their 'Grand Theft Auto' skills in real life
stories.summary: As "GTA VI" breaks entertainment records, the San Antonio Police Department is warning gamers that what happens in the fictional Leonida should stay in Leonida.

stories.title: Female police officers sue City of Dallas, alleging sex discrimination, retaliation
stories.summary: The two officers allege in the suit that they were harassed due to their sex, and restricted them to partially operational status, stripping them of core duties.

stories.title: Texas Railroad Commissioner-elect joins Inside Texas Politics to discuss priorities, how he plans to double its budget
stories.summary: Jon Rosenthal is the first Democrat Railroad Commissioner in nearly four decades, but he still has to work with two Republicans.

stories.title: Family fights parole approval for woman convicted in deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash
stories.summary: A Houston family is fighting the parole approval of a woman convicted in a deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash after she served about three years.
